In-store services

Sales, service & care

How buying works

Simple, in store
01 / BROWSE
Walk in, look around

Every collection is on display with prices marked. No pressure — take your time, ask anything.

02 / TRY ON
Feel it on your wrist

Weight, size and strap comfort only make sense on the wrist. Try as many as you like, side by side.

03 / CHECK
Bill & warranty, sorted

We set the time, size the bracelet, stamp the warranty card and hand over a proper bill.

04 / AFTERCARE
We service what we sell

Batteries, straps, polishing and full servicing at our own desk — your watch stays with people you know.
